description: This file defines the TreeCompiler class, which compiles JMESPath expressions into executable PHP code for use with the JmesPath namespace.

classes.name: TreeCompiler
classes.description: A class that compiles JMESPath expressions into native PHP code, transforming abstract syntax trees into executable PHP functions.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Compiles an AST into a PHP function with a specified name, initializing source code and defining the function structure.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches AST nodes to their corresponding visit methods based on type.

methods.name: makeVar
methods.description: Creates unique variable names with a given prefix to avoid naming collisions.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends formatted code lines to the source string, managing indentation.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level for subsequent code.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for subsequent code.

methods.name: visit_or
methods.description: Handles logical OR node in AST, implementing short-circuit evaluation.

methods.name: visit_and
methods.description: Handles logical AND node in AST, implementing short-circuit evaluation.

methods.name: visit_not
methods.description: Handles NOT node in AST, applying boolean negation.

methods.name: visit_subexpression
methods.description: Processes subexpression nodes, managing nested expressions.

methods.name: visit_field
methods.description: Accesses object or array fields based on AST node.

methods.name: visit_index
methods.description: Accesses array elements by index, including negative indices.

methods.name: visit_literal
methods.description: Handles literal value nodes.

methods.name: visit_pipe
methods.description: Handles pipe nodes, sequencing operations.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_list
methods.description: Processes multi-select list nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_hash
methods.description: Processes multi-select hash nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_function
methods.description: Handles function call nodes, dispatching arguments appropriately.

methods.name: visit_slice
methods.description: Processes slice nodes in AST, creating slices with start, end, and step.

methods.name: visit_current
methods.description: Handles current node ('@') in AST, which is a no-op.

methods.name: visit_expref
methods.description: Processes expression reference nodes, creating closures that invoke the interpreter.

methods.name: visit_flatten
methods.description: Flattens nested arrays within the AST.

methods.name: visit_projection
methods.description: Handles projection nodes, filtering and transforming arrays.

methods.name: visit_condition
methods.description: Processes conditional nodes, evaluating predicate and branches.

methods.name: visit_comparator
methods.description: Handles comparison operators ('==', '!=', etc.) in AST.
